Ukraine carried out its largest drone attack of 2026, destroying a major Wildberries distribution hub near Moscow and killing at least seven people.
A separate Russian strike killed a Ukrainian woman elsewhere in the country the same day.
ADNOC confirmed one of its tankers came under attack while transiting the Strait of Hormuz, the third such Iranian attack on commercial shipping in less than a week.
An Israeli airstrike on a house in the southern Lebanese town of Ansar killed at least seven people and wounded three, the deadliest strike in Lebanon since the June ceasefire.
An Israeli drone strike targeted a motorcycle in Deir al-Balah, central Gaza, wounding three Palestinians despite the active ceasefire.
Iran's IRGC said it shot down a US-made MQ-9 Reaper drone over southern Hormozgan province.
NATO fighter jets intercepted and shot down a foreign drone after it entered Latvian airspace.
Ukrainian drones struck Ust-Luga, Russia's primary Baltic oil export terminal, igniting a fire at the facility.
The same overnight operation included a Ukrainian drone attack on a warehouse near Moscow.
Russia said its forces struck Ukrainian railway and port facilities in retaliation for Ukrainian drone strikes on Russian energy infrastructure.
A Russian missile strike sparked a fire at a Ukrainian port, part of a sustained campaign against Ukraine's maritime infrastructure.
Two Adnoc-owned vessels were attacked while transiting the Strait of Hormuz; no injuries were reported and no perpetrator was named.
Yemen's Houthi movement claimed it launched two drones at Saudi Aramco's refinery in Jazan.
US Central Command disabled a Panama-flagged cargo tanker in the Gulf of Oman for attempting to violate the US naval blockade on Iranian ports.
A drone attack ignited a gasoline storage unit at Libya's largest operating refinery in Zawiya, prompting the state oil company to warn it may halt operations.
A Houthi missile struck a commercial ship transiting the Bab el-Mandeb strait, killing three crew members — two Pakistani nationals and one Indonesian.
A Houthi missile barrage on the Yemeni port town of al-Makha killed seven people.

Russia fired North Korean ballistic missiles in overnight strikes on Zaporizhzhia, killing at least six people and injuring 19, part of a wider campaign that killed nine across Ukraine; the toll later rose to 10.
A Saudi Aramco refinery in Jizan erupted in flames after a Houthi drone strike, the group claimed; the Saudi energy ministry confirmed the fire but not its cause.
Ukrainian drone strikes hit the oil refinery hub of Nizhnekamsk in Russia's Tatarstan region, killing at least 13 people and wounding 39.
Houthi forces struck the Saudi oil tanker Wafa off Yanbu with missiles, the eighth Saudi vessel hit since their July 22 Bab el-Mandeb blockade declaration.
Ukrainian drones struck Russian oil refineries in the Yaroslavl region and Bashkortostan, part of a deep-strike campaign on Russian refining capacity.
A two-hour Russian missile and drone barrage on Kyiv and the surrounding region killed at least 17 people and wounded 44.
An Indian-flagged commercial vessel sank after a Houthi attack in the Red Sea.

place: Engels air base and Saratov oil refinery, Russia; Crimea
summary: Ukrainian drones killed nine people in southern Russia and occupied Crimea, striking military and fuel infrastructure including the Engels air base and the Saratov oil refinery.
Russia struck Zaporizhzhia with eight glide bombs over roughly 90 minutes, killing one person, injuring 31, and damaging 22 apartment buildings.

place: Gaza City, Deir al-Balah and Khan Younis, Gaza
summary: Israeli airstrikes killed at least 18 Palestinians in Gaza City, Deir al-Balah and Khan Younis over the weekend, the enclave's highest daily death toll in weeks.
Russia struck Kyiv with ballistic missiles and drones, killing at least nine people and wounding dozens; the barrage damaged the Lithuanian embassy.
Iran said its forces struck two commercial tankers transiting the Strait of Hormuz under US Navy escort.
Iran's IRGC claimed ballistic missiles struck Al-Azraq Air Base in Jordan, destroying three US F-35 jets; neither the Pentagon nor Jordan confirmed the claim.
Iran's military said it struck "strategic US centres" in Kuwait with drones in retaliation for US strikes on Qeshm Island and other Iranian sites.
A US strike hit a residential home on Qeshm Island, Iran, prompting Iranian retaliation against US facilities in Kuwait.
A Russian missile violated Polish airspace and detonated on Polish territory, prompting NATO to scramble fighter jets.

place: Bandar Abbas, Abu Musa, Kish Island and Qeshm Island, Iran
summary: US forces struck southern Iran, with explosions reported at Bandar Abbas and the islands of Abu Musa, Kish and Qeshm, in retaliation for Iran's missile attack on a US base in Jordan.
A suspected drone strike hit the floating LNG storage tanker Energos Winter at Egypt's Damietta Port, sparking a fire that spread to the LNG carrier Gaslog Salem.
US and Saudi forces conducted coordinated airstrikes on Popular Mobilisation Forces headquarters across several Iraqi provinces, killing at least 20 fighters and wounding 32.

place: Near Piranshahr, West Azerbaijan Province, Iran
summary: A US missile struck an uninhabited area near the northwestern Iranian border city of Piranshahr, the first reported US strike on Iranian soil in this cycle.

Russia launched a sweeping missile and drone assault across Ukraine from east to west, killing at least 13 people; Western intelligence said Russia likely used a North Korean-supplied ballistic missile for the first time this year.
A Houthi drone attack hit Saudi Aramco's Abqaiq oil processing and stabilisation facility, forcing a halt in operations.

place: Erbil, Soran and Khalifan, Iraqi Kurdistan
summary: Drone attacks struck bases of Iranian Kurdish opposition parties in Erbil, Soran and Khalifan in Iraq's Kurdistan region; coalition air defenses intercepted other drones over Erbil.
Iran's IRGC fired at least four ballistic missiles at a US military base in Jordan in an attempted surprise attack, the first disclosed Iranian strike on US forces since the pause.
Houthi forces claimed a ballistic missile strike on the Saudi oil tanker NCC Ghazal, forcing it to turn back.
Ukraine struck a major Russian oil refinery and multiple industrial sites in Russia and Crimea, killing at least three people.
A Houthi attack damaged the Integrated Gasification unit at Saudi Aramco's Jazan refinery, prompting a shutdown of the 400,000-barrel-per-day facility.
Israeli and Jordanian air defenses intercepted drones near the Dead Sea amid a wider Iran-linked drone campaign.
Ukrainian drones struck Russia's Belgorod region.
Russian missiles and drones struck Kyiv overnight, sparking fires across multiple districts.
US forces disabled a tanker in the Strait of Hormuz that was attempting to evade the American blockade on Iranian ports.
Houthi ballistic missiles targeted Saudi Aramco oil facilities in Jizan and the Red Sea port of Yanbu; Saudi air defenses intercepted the missiles.
Ukraine struck an Iranian vessel in the Caspian Sea carrying drone and missile components bound for Russia, killing at least one sailor.
Russian ballistic missiles struck a drone and weapons exhibition in Kyiv, killing at least 10 people and wounding more than 100.
Russia accused Ukraine of a strike that killed 11 people at a tourist camp.
Iran's IRGC said its naval forces barred four vessels from transiting the Strait of Hormuz within a 24-hour period.

place: Bandar Abbas and islands, Strait of Hormuz, Iran
summary: US forces struck Bandar Abbas and islands in the Strait of Hormuz in a 13th consecutive night of strikes, injuring at least two people.
Bahrain and Kuwait sent warplanes to bomb Iranian military targets in retaliation for Iranian strikes on their territory, with UAE support, the Wall Street Journal reported.

place: Kuwait and US military sites in Jordan
summary: Iran struck Kuwait and US military infrastructure in Jordan overnight, part of a second week of aerial attacks on Gulf states.
Explosive-laden drones struck a military base in northern Iraq hosting US forces, hours after CENTCOM's 13th night of strikes on Iran.
A drone attack struck the Abdali border crossing between Kuwait and Iraq, causing damage but no casualties.
US Central Command completed a 12th consecutive night of strikes on Iran, deploying a B-1 bomber flown from the United Kingdom for the first time in the campaign.
A US strike on Iran's Shalamcheh border crossing with Iraq killed at least two people and wounded eleven others.
Bahrain's air defenses intercepted and destroyed a number of Iranian aerial threats.
US Central Command said American forces began a new round of strikes on Iranian military targets at Trump's direction, distinct from the earlier overnight 11th-night wave.
Jordan's air defenses intercepted four Iranian ballistic missiles and four drones overnight, with explosions visible over Eilat.
Yemen's Houthis claimed missile and drone attacks on two Saudi-flagged oil tankers in the Red Sea, calling it enforcement of a declared maritime embargo on the kingdom.
US forces struck Iran for an 11th consecutive night, with explosions reported across multiple areas of the country.
Kuwait's air defenses intercepted a barrage of Iranian missiles and drones.
Three explosive-laden drones were shot down near the US consulate in Erbil, Iraq; no group claimed responsibility.
A Russian drone strike set a shopping centre in Sumy ablaze.
Ukrainian forces struck six vessels in the Black Sea as part of a coordinated series of long-range strikes.

place: Caspian Pipeline Consortium terminal, Black Sea
summary: A drone struck a tanker loading crude oil at the Caspian Pipeline Consortium's Black Sea export terminal, forcing a halt to exports.
A Russian strike on a vessel near Odesa killed at least 10 people.
UKMTO said it received multiple reports that a tanker was struck by an unknown projectile in the Strait of Hormuz.

place: Bandar Abbas, Sirik Island and Qeshm, Iran
summary: CENTCOM opened a tenth consecutive night of strikes on Iran, with explosions reported at Bandar Abbas, Sirik Island and Qeshm.
A reported US strike on the northwestern Iranian city of Tabriz killed an Iranian military officer, the first strike to reach the city in the current conflict.
Ukrainian forces struck a Russian oil depot and logistics facilities in Moscow Oblast.
Russia accused Ukraine of a drone strike that hit a passenger bus in a Russian border region, killing five civilians; Kyiv did not confirm responsibility.
Iran's IRGC said its forces struck two oil tankers transiting the Strait of Hormuz, with both ships reportedly exploding.
Iran's IRGC fired a missile toward Jordan's Red Sea port of Aqaba, the first such strike to reach that location in the current conflict.

place: Camp Arifjan and Ali Al Salem Air Base, Kuwait
summary: Iran's IRGC claimed it struck a US military support center at Kuwait's Camp Arifjan and destroyed a radar facility at Ali Al Salem Air Base.
US forces struck the construction site of Iran's Darkhovin nuclear power plant.
US forces struck Iranian targets for a ninth consecutive night, aimed at degrading Iran's ability to threaten shipping in the Strait of Hormuz.
A US service member was killed in Iraq during a controlled detonation of an Iranian munition, the third US military fatality tied to the Iran conflict in 48 hours.
Iran fired drones at US military personnel in Kuwait while Iranian-aligned forces also targeted Bahrain.
At least six missiles struck Qeshm Island in the Strait of Hormuz as part of the US campaign against Iran.

place: Southern Iran and near the Strait of Hormuz
summary: US forces struck Iran overnight for an eighth consecutive night, with strikes hitting southern Iran and targets around the Strait of Hormuz.
Russian ballistic missiles struck Kyiv in what Zelensky called one of the most massive ballistic attacks on the capital since the invasion began, killing one and wounding 13.
US airstrikes cut water access for roughly 10,000 residents across 20 villages in Iran's Hormozgan province.

place: Bandar Abbas, Qeshm Island and Larak Island, Iran
summary: US forces struck coastal installations near Bandar Abbas and the islands of Qeshm and Larak in a seventh consecutive night of strikes on Iran.
A US soldier, Sgt. Michael Swinton, was killed at Erbil air base in Iraq during a controlled detonation of an intercepted Iranian attack drone.

place: Highway tunnel and bridges linking Bandar Abbas to Hajiabad, Iran
summary: US forces struck a highway tunnel and at least two bridges linking Bandar Abbas to Hajiabad, continuing a campaign against Iranian transportation infrastructure.
Iranian forces struck Kuwait's main water desalination and power plant, causing widespread damage and a fire.

place: Moscow region and Tambov, Russia (Wildberries warehouses)
summary: Ukrainian drone strikes hit Wildberries warehouses near Moscow and in Tambov, killing seven workers and sparking an oil depot fire.
US Marines boarded the tanker M/T Wen Yao in the Gulf of Oman as part of the renewed blockade of Iranian ports.
Iran's IRGC claimed it attacked a US special operations command center at the al-Tanf military base in Syria.

place: Bridges in southern Iran, including Bandar Khamir
summary: US airstrikes destroyed five bridges and a port tower in southern Iran, killing at least seven civilians.
Kurdish forces shot down eight explosive drones over Erbil in northern Iraq.

place: Ghanim region and maritime radar in the Strait of Hormuz, Oman
summary: Iran's IRGC said it struck a US air control radar in Oman's northern Ghanim region and a maritime surveillance radar in the Strait of Hormuz.
Iran's IRGC launched a missile and drone attack on Muwaffaq Salti Air Base in Jordan, killing two American service members, leaving one missing, and wounding four.
Falling shrapnel from intercepted Iranian fire caused a minor injury to a child in Qatar.
Iran's IRGC said it targeted US helicopters and reconnaissance aircraft at Bahrain's Sakhir air base.
Iran's IRGC claimed hits on a missile defense radar, weapons depots, and two HIMARS launchers at a US base in Kuwait.
Ukraine's Omega special forces unit claimed a drone strike hit a Russian Su-24 bomber in occupied Crimea.

place: Strait of Hormuz, en route to Kharg Island
summary: US forces disabled an unladen oil tanker with Hellfire missiles as it tried to reach Iran's Kharg Island crude export terminal.
Iran's IRGC said it targeted US soldiers and communications systems at bases in Jordan and Kuwait, with Iranian fire also hitting Bahrain.
US forces struck locations near Qeshm Island in southern Iran in a sixth consecutive night of strikes.
US strikes expanded into northern Iran and hit closer to Tehran for the first time since the current wave of attacks began.
Ukrainian forces struck 20 Russian vessels in the Black Sea, including 17 oil tankers, in one of the largest single-day naval strikes of the war.

place: Bampur, Sistan and Baluchestan Province, Iran
summary: US strikes killed at least seven Iranian personnel at an army base in Bampur, Sistan and Baluchestan province.

place: Iran (air defense, coastal radar, missile and drone sites)
summary: US forces struck a second wave of Iranian military targets Wednesday evening, hitting air defense, coastal radar, and missile and drone sites.
Kuwait intercepted a batch of Iranian missiles and drones amid the widening US-Iran exchange.

place: Marine control tower and an island near Strait of Hormuz, Iran
summary: US forces struck an Iranian marine control tower and an island near the Strait of Hormuz, targeting capabilities used to attack shipping.
Russia struck Kyiv with ballistic missiles, hitting a warehouse and buildings in the Sviatoshynskyi and Darnytskyi districts, killing two and wounding six, including a 16-year-old.
Russia launched a new wave of missile and drone strikes against Ukraine, sparking fires that required emergency response.
Russia said a Ukrainian drone strike killed the chief engineer at the Zaporizhzhia Nuclear Power Plant; Kyiv did not confirm the strike.
Iranian missiles struck two UAE-flagged oil tankers in the southern lane of the Strait of Hormuz, killing one sailor and wounding eight, the UAE Defense Ministry said.
U.S. forces struck Iranian port cities Bushehr and Bandar Abbas in a third consecutive night of strikes, killing at least three people.

place: Hajiabad and Sirik, Hormozgan Province, Iran
summary: U.S. forces struck dozens of additional military targets near the Strait of Hormuz, including sites near Hajiabad and Sirik in Hormozgan province.

place: Kuwait, Bahrain and Jordan (U.S. military sites)
summary: Iran's IRGC said it attacked U.S. forces in Kuwait, Bahrain and Jordan, with explosions reported in Kuwait and drone strikes on a U.S. position in Jordan; no injuries were reported.
U.S. forces struck Iran for a fourth consecutive day, with Iranian state TV reporting a strike on Qeshm Island in the Persian Gulf.
Saudi air defenses intercepted a ballistic missile fired from Houthi-held Yemen in what the group called retaliation for earlier strikes; no casualties were reported.
Ukrainian air-defense batteries intercepted five Russian ballistic missiles in an overnight exchange.
U.S. missiles struck three locations in Iran's oil city of Abadan, killing at least two people and wounding three.
Iran's IRGC said it struck U.S.-linked military facilities in Bahrain, Kuwait and Oman in retaliation for the latest U.S. strikes on Iran.
A U.S. strike on a military base in Isfahan, Iran, killed at least one person and wounded seven, part of a broader wave hitting dozens of Iranian sites.
U.S. Navy Corsair unmanned surface vessels struck an Iranian submarine and ship-maintenance facility at Bandar Abbas, the first combat use of sea drones by the U.S. military.
Iran's IRGC said its forces struck U.S. aircraft-carrier support and refueling platforms at the port of Duqm, Oman.
U.S. forces struck Iranian missile systems and coastal-defense infrastructure near the Strait of Hormuz in two strike waves, with Trump saying the U.S. had hit Iran "very hard."
Iranian drones and missiles struck Kuwait, injuring three people, including a child, by falling debris, during a Gulf-wide retaliatory wave.
Iran struck sites in Oman's Musandam and al-Batinah governorates with drones, prompting Muscat to summon Iran's ambassador in protest.
Iran fired missiles and drones at U.S. military sites in Qatar, injuring three people with falling shrapnel.
Iran claimed responsibility for a strike on a U.S. base in Jordan amid a wider retaliatory wave across the Gulf.
Ukrainian drones struck Enerhodar, the Russian-controlled city adjacent to Europe's largest nuclear plant, killing four people, Russian officials said.
A Russian guided bomb strike on Sumy killed five people, including a child, and wounded 43 others.
Iran's IRGC struck a container ship transiting the Strait of Hormuz via what Tehran called an unapproved route, prompting a U.S. retaliatory strike wave.
CENTCOM's third round of strikes on Iran, launched after an IRGC attack on a container ship in the Strait of Hormuz, killed Iranian navy Lieutenant Hamidreza Dehghani.
An Israeli drone strike hit a civilian vehicle near the Nuseirat refugee camp in central Gaza, killing one Palestinian and wounding two others despite an active ceasefire.
Russia launched an overnight missile and drone attack on Ukraine using ballistic missiles, cruise missiles and drones, killing two and wounding 19, including 11 in Kyiv.

place: Iranshahr Airport and Chabahar Port, Iran
summary: U.S. strikes killed a firefighter at Iranshahr airport and hit maritime traffic control infrastructure at Chabahar port in southeastern Iran.
Iran fired 10 missiles at Jordan, widening its retaliatory campaign against U.S. partners in the region.
Jets struck the naval military zone in Iran's Konarak after two explosions, with the U.S. denying responsibility for the strike.
U.S. forces struck a railway bridge in northern Iran on the transit corridor linking Iran to Russia and China.
Ukrainian drones set at least two oil tankers ablaze in the Sea of Azov as part of a campaign against Russian energy exports.
Iran's IRGC struck Ali Al-Salem Air Base in Kuwait as part of a retaliatory wave against U.S. military sites in the Gulf.

place: Bandar Salman and Fifth Fleet District, Bahrain
summary: Iran's IRGC said it struck U.S. military sites in Bahrain, including Bandar Salman and the Fifth Fleet District, with no reported casualties.
U.S. Central Command struck roughly 90 Iranian military targets across five provinces, killing at least 14 people and wounding 78, Iran's Health Ministry said.
Russia struck Kyiv for a second consecutive night, killing at least three people across Ukraine, hours after Trump met Zelensky at the NATO summit.
Ukrainian drones struck multiple Russian oil storage depots, part of Kyiv's campaign to degrade Moscow's energy export infrastructure.

place: Strait of Hormuz, near Limah, Oman
summary: Iranian forces struck the Qatari LNG tanker Al-Rekayyat with a projectile in the Strait of Hormuz, causing an engine-room fire.
An Iranian-fired missile struck the Saudi-flagged crude supertanker Wedyan while it was departing the Strait of Hormuz.

place: Bandar Abbas, Sirik and Qeshm Island, Iran
summary: CENTCOM struck Iranian anti-ship missile sites, coastal radar and air-defense batteries near Bandar Abbas, Sirik and Qeshm Island in retaliation for tanker attacks.
Russia struck Kyiv with ballistic missiles, cruise missiles and drones, killing at least 11 people and damaging residential apartment buildings.

place: Ali Al Salem Air Base, Kuwait and US forces in Bahrain
summary: Iran's IRGC said its navy and air force launched ballistic missiles and drones at Ali Al Salem Air Base in Kuwait and at US forces in Bahrain; both governments confirmed the attacks, with a residential building in Manama damaged.
A Panama-flagged tanker was struck by a drone near the Strait of Hormuz, prompting a second round of US strikes on Iran.
Bahrain said it was hit by a wave of Iranian drones overnight, and Iran's IRGC said it had targeted US military forces in the region, the first Iranian response to Friday's CENTCOM strikes.
US forces conducted a second round of strikes on Iranian targets after the Panama-flagged tanker attack; Iranian state media said projectiles hit a telecommunications tower near Sirik.
President Trump said Iran fired at least four one-way attack drones at commercial ships transiting the Strait of Hormuz, calling it a ceasefire violation.

place: Iran's northern Hormuz shore (missile/drone storage, coastal radar)
summary: CENTCOM struck Iranian missile and drone storage facilities and coastal radar positions in response to the drone attack on a cargo ship in the Strait of Hormuz.

A drone attack struck the Singapore-flagged, Evergreen-operated cargo ship Ever Lovely in the Strait of Hormuz near Oman, damaging its upper deck with no casualties; the US later blamed Iran and struck Iranian targets in response.

Israeli strikes on Lebanon's Nabatieh district killed 16 people and wounded 12, part of a wider Saturday barrage that killed at least 28 across southern Lebanon after Hezbollah fired over 50 projectiles at Israeli forces.
Two Lebanese army soldiers were killed in separate Israeli airstrikes in southern Lebanon, the army said, calling it a ceasefire violation.

An Israeli soldier was killed and 13 others wounded in an attack in southern Lebanon, the second IDF combat-casualty event in 48 hours, after Hezbollah fired more than 50 projectiles at Israeli forces.
Hezbollah hit an Israeli tank in southern Lebanon, killing four IDF soldiers including a battalion commander, the first Israeli combat fatalities since the Versailles MOU.
Israeli airstrikes across southern Lebanon killed at least 28 people, the deadliest single day since the US-Iran deal came into force; a single pre-dawn strike killed at least eight.
Israeli strikes in southern Lebanon killed three people hours after Trump and Pezeshkian signed the US-Iran memorandum of understanding at Versailles.
Israeli air strikes across Lebanon's Nabatieh governorate killed at least four people, Lebanon's National News Agency said.
Israeli forces carried out strikes across southern Lebanon, the first reported breach of the ceasefire clause in the newly announced US-Iran accord.
An Israeli airstrike on Beirut's Dahieh district killed three people and wounded others; Israel said it targeted Hezbollah infrastructure.
India confirmed three dead in a separate strike on a vessel off Oman, amid the escalating Hormuz confrontation.
US Central Command shot down two Iranian-made drones near the Strait of Hormuz.
Iran's navy intercepted a commercial vessel near the Strait of Hormuz, Iranian state media said.
A second US strike package hit Iranian nuclear and military sites, prompting Iran to declare the Strait of Hormuz closed to all shipping.
A tanker caught fire off the Omani coast with two crew members reported missing, UK Maritime Trade Operations said.
IRGC fast boats fired on commercial shipping in the Strait of Hormuz, Iran's first step toward closing the waterway.

place: Southern Iran, near the Strait of Hormuz
summary: US forces carried out strikes against Iranian targets, with Iranian state media reporting explosions in southern Iran near the Strait of Hormuz, as part of the response to the downed Apache helicopter.

place: US Fifth Fleet HQ, Manama, Bahrain and a US base in Jordan
summary: Iran's IRGC launched drone attacks on the US Fifth Fleet headquarters in Manama, Bahrain, and missile strikes on a US base in Jordan; Jordanian air defenses intercepted some incoming missiles.
A US Navy F/A-18 Super Hornet struck and disabled an unladen oil tanker in the Gulf of Oman as it transited toward an Iranian loading port.
A US Army Apache helicopter went down near the Strait of Hormuz; President Trump later said Iran shot it down, though the crew was recovered safely.
A missile fired from Yemen toward Israel was intercepted before reaching Israeli territory.
Iran's IRGC said it struck Israeli air bases with ballistic missiles in retaliation for the Mahshahr petrochemical strike, in an operation it called Operation Nasr.
Israel struck Iran's Mahshahr petrochemical complex, one of the largest industrial sites on Iran's Persian Gulf coast, using air-launched ballistic missiles.
US forces shot down two Iranian drones over the Strait of Hormuz on day 100 of the war.

Iran's IRGC launched a missile barrage at Israel in response to Israeli strikes on Beirut's Dahiyeh district, with Israeli interceptors engaging inbound projectiles and sirens sounding across central and northern Israel.
Israeli aircraft struck the Dahiyeh district in Beirut's southern suburbs, the first major attack on the Lebanese capital since the US-brokered ceasefire with Hezbollah took effect.
An Israeli strike hit a Lebanese army convoy, killing a senior Lebanese officer.
US forces shot down four Iranian attack drones near the Strait of Hormuz.

place: Ali al-Salem Air Base, Kuwait and US Fifth Fleet HQ, Bahrain
summary: Iran fired seven ballistic missiles at US military bases in Kuwait and Bahrain; CENTCOM said six were intercepted and one failed to reach its target, with no US casualties.
US forces struck Iranian radar installations and coastal facilities in response to a fresh wave of Iranian drone launches, which Tehran called a ceasefire violation.
An Israeli strike on a vehicle in south Lebanon killed three Lebanese army personnel as part of a wider bombardment that killed at least 10 people across the south.
Iran's armed forces fired warning missiles at US Navy vessels in the Gulf of Oman in response to the US boarding of the sanctioned tanker MT Davina.
A drone attack caused a blast at Oman's Mina Al Fahal oil terminal, halting crude loading operations; no party claimed responsibility.

place: Indian Ocean, south of Sri Lanka
summary: US Indo-Pacific Command forces boarded and seized the sanctioned supertanker MT Davina, carrying nearly 2 million barrels of Iranian crude, in the Indian Ocean south of Sri Lanka.
US forces struck a communications tower and ground control station on Iran's Qeshm Island in the Strait of Hormuz, calling it a self-defense action.
Iran claimed a strike on the US Fifth Fleet headquarters in Bahrain; Bahrain's military said it intercepted three incoming missiles and accused Iran of attacking civilian infrastructure.
Iranian drones and missiles struck Terminal One of Kuwait International Airport, killing at least one person and wounding dozens, and suspending all flights.

A US aircraft fired a Hellfire missile into the engine room of the unladen, Botswana-flagged tanker M/T Lexie after it ignored 24 hours of warnings and attempted to breach the US naval blockade of Iran's ports.
Israeli airstrikes and shelling killed at least five people across southern Lebanon hours after Trump announced a de-escalation deal between Israel and Hezbollah.

place: Persian Gulf, near Umm Qasr, Iraq
summary: Iran's IRGC said it fired a cruise missile at the Panama-flagged container ship MSC Sariska V, calling it US-owned, in retaliation for a strike on an Iranian vessel near Oman.
Israeli forces struck Beirut's southern suburb of Dahieh, with Netanyahu separately seeking US approval for a wider air campaign on the Lebanese capital.
US Central Command struck Iranian radar and command-and-control sites for drones at Goruk and Qeshm Island, calling the operation self-defense.
Iran's IRGC said it struck a US military base in Kuwait in retaliation for US strikes on Iranian drone and radar sites along Iran's Gulf coast.
Iran's IRGC said it shot down a US MQ-1 reconnaissance drone over Iranian territorial waters in the Persian Gulf, a claim the Pentagon had not confirmed.
A US aircraft fired a Hellfire missile into the engine room of the Gambia-flagged M/V Lian Star in the Gulf of Oman after the ship ignored more than 20 warnings, disabling it.
Israeli aircraft struck a vehicle in Beirut's southern suburbs, killing a commander of the IRGC-aligned Imam Hossein Division.
Iranian forces fired warning shots at four vessels attempting to transit the Strait of Hormuz without prior coordination; the vessels were turned back.
An Iranian strike hit Kuwaiti territory, prompting Kuwait to condemn it as an attack on its sovereignty and the GCC to issue a joint condemnation.

place: Near Larak Island, Strait of Hormuz
summary: US forces struck Iranian missile sites and small boats near Larak Island that officials said were laying mines in the Strait of Hormuz, with Iranian media reporting four killed.

place: Near Bandar Abbas, Strait of Hormuz approaches
summary: US forces struck Iranian missile launch sites and small boats attempting to lay mines near the Strait of Hormuz approaches, calling the action self-defense.
US Marines boarded an Iranian-flagged oil tanker in the Gulf of Oman, searched it, and ordered the crew to alter course under the US blockade on Iranian ports.

place: Barakah Nuclear Energy Plant, Abu Dhabi
summary: A drone strike sparked a fire at a generator outside the UAE's Barakah nuclear plant; the UAE blamed Iran or its proxies, with no injuries reported.
Hezbollah claimed a strike on an Israeli tank and bulldozers near the Lebanon-Israel border.
Israeli strikes killed at least seven people in southern Lebanon the same day a 45-day ceasefire extension with Israel was announced.

place: Gulf of Oman, near UAE waters
summary: Iranian naval forces boarded and detained a vessel described as a "floating armoury" in the Gulf of Oman near UAE territorial waters.

place: 23 nautical miles northeast of Doha, Qatar
summary: An unknown projectile struck a bulk carrier about 23 nautical miles northeast of Doha, sparking a small fire that the crew extinguished with no casualties.
UAE air defenses engaged Iranian ballistic missiles and drones launched at Emirati territory, with three people wounded in the first acknowledged Iranian strike on the UAE this escalation.

place: Gulf of Oman, near the Strait of Hormuz
summary: US naval forces fired precision strikes disabling the Iranian-flagged tankers M/T Sea Star III and M/T Sevda as they attempted to breach the US naval blockade.
Iran's navy boarded and seized the Barbados-registered tanker Ocean Koi in the Gulf of Oman, accusing it of disrupting Iranian oil exports.
The ADNOC-affiliated tanker M.V. Barakah was struck by two drones while transiting the Strait of Hormuz.
US naval forces sank six Iranian small boats that approached a commercial convoy during the first Project Freedom escort transit through the Strait of Hormuz.
Iran launched ballistic missiles, cruise missiles and drones at the Fujairah oil export hub in the UAE, igniting a fire and wounding three Indian nationals.
